class.name: RailVehicleElectricSeriesEngine
class.brief_description: Subclass of RailVehicleElectricEngine. Adds additional parameters for more specific engines

method.name: get_circuit_imin
method.description: The current the automatic start steps on below [lb]A[rb] ([code]Imin[/code]: [code]IminLo[/code], or [code]IminHi[/code] switched high).

method.name: get_circuit_imin_high_enabled
method.description: Whether the automatic start steps on the high current ([code]Imin == IminHi[/code]). State key [code]circuit_imin_high_enabled[/code].

method.name: get_next_position_velocity
method.description: The speed [km/h] above which the next position of the master controller (or, with [param main_controller] false, of the field shunt) keeps the motor current within its limit and the wheels within their adhesion ([code]TController::ESMVelocity()[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:2344[/code]).

method.name: get_resistor_fan_rotation
method.description: How fast the starting resistors' fan turns ([code]RventRot[/code]).

members.member: [code]Param:Type=ezt[/code] The reverser's step past "forward" switches the automatic start to the high current, and its step back from there to the low one (TMoverParameters::DirectionForward/Backward, Mover.cpp:719, 3250). In the config dump, with [code]direction_position_max[/code] - the reverser key's last position.
[code]Engine:nmax[/code] Maximum allowed motor rotation speed, in RPM.
[code]Engine:Volt[/code] Rated voltage of the motor, in volts
[code]RList:RVentnmax[/code] Maximum rotation speed of the starting resistor cooling fans.
[code]RList:RVent[/code] How the starting resistor cooling fans are driven: not present, always on, or automatically controlled.

constants.constant: A resistor fan switched by itself ([code]RVent=Automatic[/code]).
